EX-99.1 2 ex991.htm NEWS RELEASE DATED SEPTEMBER 16, 2026 EXHIBIT 99.1 Cardiol Therapeutics Announces Warrant Exercise for Over USD $7 Million in Proceeds Proceeds strengthen balance sheet ahead of pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial data readout in recurrent pericarditis and extends cash runway into H1 2028.

The capital raised will extend Cardiol's cash runway into H1 2028, fund operations through topline data readout from the pivotal Phase III MAVERIC trial of CardiolRx ™ in recurrent pericarditis, and provide the Company with additional flexibility and working capital as it moves beyond that significant milestone.
